title: Gemini Omni Flash Changes Everything! ⚡️
description:
Try Gemini Omni Flash: https://higgsfield.ai/s/gemini-omni-flash-higgsfieldai-GIRovH

See how Gemini Omni Flash on Higgsfield handles real-time fitness tracking and navigation.

We test the app's ability to analyze yoga poses and exercise form while mapping routes for outdoor runs. Whether you need a virtual coach for your lunges or help planning a park route, this demo shows what the technology can actually do.
